videos.script: Ask a model about your company's refund policy, and it will answer. {{ask}} It has never read your policy. So the answer is a likely refund policy, not yours. {{likely}} Retrieval-augmented generation fixes that with one idea. Before the model writes, you look up the relevant passages yourself. {{lookup}} Then you paste them into the prompt, numbered, and ask the model to answer from them and cite them. {{paste}} In this lesson you do the looking up with a real search over a café's staff handbook. You see the scores, and the prompt it builds. {{search}} Then you watch it fail. A question with different words finds nothing. A passage cut in the wrong place hides the answer. And a confident search returns the wrong rule. {{fail}} Knowing those failures is most of using retrieval well. {{well}}
